title: Round Masks and Profiles
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: The masks in this room are round, or turned sideways. A head drawn as a ring or an oval, with a border of dots or spikes, and the parts arranged inside it: hearts, flowers, spirals and crosses for eyes, and a mouth of teeth that sometimes takes the whole lower half. Twenty-one works, from June 8 to August 19, 2022.

Six of them come from a single day, July 9, when the round mask was found and tried six times in twelve hours. Each of the six has a different pair of eyes. One has a heart pierced by an arrow. One has a flower and a heart together. One has a spiral and a flower. One has an eye like a wheel.
Watch the mouth. In the first mask it is a small open hole with teeth inside. By August it is a jaw of white teeth as wide as the face, and the last mask in the room is a skull with one gold eye.

chapters.title: Two from June
chapters.opening: Before the round masks there were two oval ones, a week apart: a gold head with a spiral eye, and a grey skull with a grin.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #140
works.text: A gold head in a frame of dark teal, drawn in loose loops of pink, blue and yellow line over a painted face. One eye is a spiral, the other is a cross in a box, and the mouth is a small open hole with teeth drawn inside it. Two red bars cross the brow. It is the first work of the mask summer, drawn on June 8, 2022, and it still has a painted face under the line, something the later masks let go of.
works.caption: A gold painted head drawn over with loose loops, one spiral eye, one crossed eye, a small open mouth.
works.reading: The painting underneath is in soft gold and olive with grey shadow at the cheeks. The lines over it are long and loose, in pink, blue, white and black, and they circle the whole head several times. The mouth is a red oval with a row of small teeth inside. Recorded with 275 strokes and 79,222 points.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #143
works.text: A grey skull in a grey room, drawn in white and black line with spiky blue lashes, a grin of white teeth and yellow and red bars behind it.
works.caption: A grey skull in a grey room, spiky blue lashes, a grin of white teeth, yellow and red bars behind.
works.reading: The skull is drawn as a rounded square with two hollow eye sockets and a small heart-shaped nose. The lashes are short blue strokes standing out from the eyes. The teeth are a row of white blocks outlined in black. Seventy-one recorded strokes, the fewest in the room.

chapters.title: Six in a Day
chapters.opening: July 9, 2022. Six round masks in twelve hours, each with a different pair of eyes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #173
works.text: A round mask on blue, with a red heart pierced by an arrow for one eye and a yellow flower for the other, a grille of white teeth in a box below, and a border of zigzag and beads around the edge. The face is filled with blue, red and green scribble, and a green coil sits at the lower left like an ear. It is the first of the six, drawn at 05:43 UTC, and the arrow through the heart is the one thing in the room that tells a story.
works.caption: A round mask on blue, a heart pierced by an arrow for one eye, a yellow flower for the other.
works.reading: The heart is drawn in red with a white edge and a black arrow through it from the left. The flower has yellow petals and a red center. The teeth are a box of white bars with a red zigzag under them. A loop of yellow line at the lower right ends in a small hook.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #174
works.text: Half an hour later, a round mask on teal with a red X in a white box for one eye and a black spiral in a red box for the other, a mouth of white fangs below.
works.caption: A round mask on teal, one eye a red X in a white box, the other a black spiral.
works.reading: The two eyes sit at different heights, the X higher and to the left. The fangs are white triangles in a red mouth at the lower left. The face is filled with red, blue and black scribble, with white loops around the edge. Eighty recorded strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #175
works.text: A pale blue mask with a border of purple dots, a wheel for one eye, a ringed eye for the other, and a mouth of white bars at the lower right.
works.caption: A pale blue mask bordered with purple dots, a spoked wheel for one eye, a ring for the other.
works.reading: The dots are purple circles with green centers, drawn around the whole edge of the face. The wheel eye has spokes drawn in black inside a yellow ring. A yellow band runs over the head like a headband, and the lower half of the face is olive and blue with a white zigzag.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #176
works.text: A round mask on blue with a red heart for one eye and a lilac flower for the other, a bar of white teeth crossing the lower face, and a border of yellow petals.
works.caption: A round mask ringed with yellow petals, a red heart for one eye, a lilac flower for the other.
works.reading: The heart and the flower are both ringed with yellow petals, and the border around the face is a ring of yellow and red petals too, so the whole mask is a flower. The teeth are a long bar of white and red that ends in a point at the right like an arrow. Green zigzag runs along the bottom.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #178
works.text: An olive mask with a big blue spiral for one eye and a small red flower for the other, a mouth of white fangs in a red box, and a border of yellow spikes with pink and blue beads. Where the morning's first mask had a heart and an arrow, this one has a spiral so large it fills a quarter of the face, and the flower beside it is pushed up into the corner. The eyes do not match in size, color or kind.
works.caption: An olive mask whose left eye is a huge blue spiral and whose right eye is a small red flower.
works.reading: The spiral is drawn in blue and white over an orange ring, and it turns a dozen times. The fangs are white triangles with black behind them in a red box that sits at the lower left. The spikes around the edge are yellow strokes with pink beads between them. Recorded with 141 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #179
works.text: A dark oval mask with a flower for one eye and a crossed eye for the other, a grille of white teeth, and a border of blue beads inside a ring of black spikes, on a ground of dark teal scribbled with yellow. The last of the six, drawn at 18:14 UTC, and the most worked, with 382 recorded strokes. The border is as busy as the face: beads, spikes, yellow loops and a second ring of blue around all of it.
works.caption: A dark oval mask with a flower eye and a crossed eye, bordered by blue beads and black spikes.
works.reading: The flower eye is red with a yellow center, drawn at the left; the crossed eye is a blue X in a red box at the right. Between them a column of black spikes runs up the forehead. The teeth are a white grille in a red box with a second row of yellow below. The ground is dark teal with yellow scribble in loose loops.

chapters.title: Beams, Hearts and Beaks
chapters.opening: July 10 to 27. A beam returns, two hearts make a pair of eyes, a mask grows a beak, and the line loosens.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #180
works.text: A gold framed head with two glowing eyes, beams pouring from them across the square, a grille of grey teeth and a row of red bars at the bottom.
works.caption: A gold framed head with two glowing eyes, beams pouring across the square, a grille of grey teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two soft yellow discs with bright centers, and the beams are broad pale wedges that cross the face from the upper left. The teeth are grey bars in a dark box. The red bars at the bottom are drawn as tall capsules with scribble inside. Recorded with 150 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #181
works.text: A yellow mask with two red hearts for eyes, a wide mouth of white teeth in a red box, and a black border drawn in one loose loop.
works.caption: A yellow mask with two red hearts for eyes and a wide mouth of white teeth in a red box.
works.reading: The hearts are red with white hatching and a dark outline, and the left one sits in a frame of white loops. The teeth are a row of white blocks in a red box that tilts down to the right. A black zigzag runs along the top, and two black lines hang from the top edge like strings. Eighty strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #187
works.text: A magenta mask with a beak like a bird, a ringed eye at the left and a cluster of yellow dots at the right, a mouth of white and yellow bars, and a border of green beads.
works.caption: A magenta mask with a bird's beak, a ringed eye, a cluster of yellow dots, a mouth of striped bars.
works.reading: The beak is drawn at the left as a pointed shape with blue zigzag inside it. The cluster of yellow dots at the right sits in a purple circle like a second eye. The mouth is a bar of white and yellow blocks running across the lower face. Green beads run along the top and the left edge.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #188
works.caption: A green skull mask outlined in yellow, spiky eyes, a long white nose, red beads down both sides.
works.reading: The skull is drawn as a tall oval in yellow and black line with green inside. The eyes are two dark circles with spiky lashes in white and blue, and the nose is a long white triangle. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. Red beads run down both sides like a necklace.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #192
works.text: A green and yellow mask with a black spiral at the upper left and a round eye with a red band across it, a mouth of red fangs and a second mouth of white teeth below.
works.caption: A green and yellow mask with a black spiral and a banded round eye, red fangs above white teeth.
works.reading: The round eye at the center is a ring with a white pupil, and a red bar crosses it like a blindfold. The spiral at the upper left is drawn in black over yellow. The two mouths sit one above the other, red fangs in the middle and white teeth at the lower left. Purple bars stand at the lower right.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #198
works.text: A sketchy face on olive, drawn in black, yellow and orange loops, one dark eye at the left and a ringed eye at the right, a pink spiral on the cheek and a mouth of white teeth.
works.caption: A sketchy face on olive in black, yellow and orange loops, a pink spiral on the cheek, white teeth.
works.reading: The line is the loosest in the room, with the head drawn in overlapping loops that never close. The dark eye at the left is a black knot; the right eye is a ring with a dark center. The pink spiral sits on the cheek like a blush. Sixty-seven recorded strokes.

chapters.title: August Jaws
chapters.opening: August 11 to 19. The mouth takes over. Six masks with jaws of white teeth as wide as the face, and a skull to end the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #217
works.text: A round mask on dark blue with a crown of yellow rays, a white flower for one eye and a square with a spiral for the other, and a wide grin of white teeth curving across the lower half. Red zigzag runs down the left side of the grin, and small blue and yellow drops fall beside it. The rays around the edge are drawn as yellow spikes with white beads between them, so the head is a sun.
works.caption: A round mask on dark blue crowned with yellow rays, a white flower for one eye, a wide curving grin.
works.reading: The flower eye is drawn in white petals with a dark center and sits in a yellow box. The spiral eye is in a red box with yellow zigzag around it. The grin curves up at the right like a crescent, with white teeth in a red mouth. Recorded with 158 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #222
works.text: A big round head with a red target for one eye and a triangle with a blue eye for the other, a jaw of white teeth in a red mouth, drawn in black line over yellow and green.
works.caption: A big round head with a red target eye and a triangle eye, white teeth in a red jaw.
works.reading: The head is drawn as a thick black circle that fills the square, and the jaw at the bottom is a wide red mouth with a row of white blocks. The target eye is red and yellow rings with a dark center. The triangle eye at the right holds a blue ring. Green bars stand along the top like hair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #223
works.text: A mask with a blue spiral eye and a red square eye, a flower at the right, a jaw of white teeth at the left, and a pale blue bar running down across the face like a strap.
works.caption: A mask with a blue spiral eye and a red square eye, a pale blue strap drawn across the face.
works.reading: The strap is a wide pale blue band drawn from the upper right to the lower left, over the mouth. The teeth are white blocks in a red box at the left. The flower at the right is drawn in pink and blue loops. Spikes stand up from both eyes like lashes. Recorded with 250 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #224
works.text: A boxy head on red and blue with a green ringed eye and a red ringed eye, a long nose, and a row of white triangle teeth in a black mouth.
works.caption: A boxy head with a green ringed eye and a red one, a long nose, white triangle teeth in black.
works.reading: The eyes are each a ring in a box, green on the left and red on the right, with the green one spiraling. The nose is a long white shape with a yellow tip. The teeth are white triangles pointing up and down in a black bar. Yellow and green zigzag fills the lower corners.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #226
works.text: A brown round mask with a yellow eye and a green eye, blue bars for a nose, and a jaw of white teeth that takes up the whole lower half, with a yellow zigzag running along the bottom lip. Orange flames stand at the top corners. The head is drawn as one thick black ring over soft brown paint. In June the first mask had a small hole of a mouth with teeth drawn inside; here the mouth is the biggest thing on the face.
works.caption: A brown round mask with mismatched eyes and a jaw of white teeth filling its lower half.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as a row of white rounded blocks, each with a grey shadow, in a red mouth that curves up at both ends. The blue bars of the nose are four short vertical strokes. The flames at the corners are orange and yellow strokes standing up from the frame. Recorded with 233 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #227
works.text: A head in profile on red-brown, facing left, with a yellow eye in a box, a black zigzag along the brow, and a mouth of white bars at the lower left.
works.caption: A head in profile on red-brown, facing left, a yellow boxed eye, white bars for a mouth.
works.reading: The profile is drawn in black line with a blue spiral on the cheek and red loops over the whole square. The eye at the upper right is a yellow box with a spiral inside. The mouth is a box of white bars outlined in red. Ninety-five recorded strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #230
works.text: A grey skull with one eye a ring of teal and one a gold target with spikes, a red beam leaving the gold eye to the right, and a mouth of white and black bars. The skull is drawn in white and black line over grey and gold paint, with purple and blue scribble falling through it. It is the last work of the mask summer, drawn August 19, 2022, a few hours after the last square mask.
works.caption: A grey skull with a teal ringed eye and a gold spiked eye, a red beam leaving the gold one.
works.reading: The gold eye is drawn as a ring of yellow spikes around a dark center, and the beam from it is two red bars with white zigzag inside. The teal eye is a ring with a red zigzag across it. The teeth are white bars with black between them in a red mouth. Recorded with 138 strokes.

closing: Look again at the six masks from July 9. They were made in one day, and every one of them has a different pair of eyes: a heart and a flower, an X and a spiral, a wheel and a ring. Then look at the brown mask from August, where the mouth has taken over. The eyes were the game in July. By August it was the jaw.
